# AltoClef Humanoid

> A human-like Minecraft bot (1.18.2 Fabric, fork of AltoClef/Baritone) that autonomously beats the game without x-ray or wall-hacks: perception limited to what it has actually seen (visibility-filtered experience memory), human-like biased exploration strategies, and human-like gaze/presentation. Experimental multi-bot + LLM director bridge exists but is a peripheral, unpolished facility.

- Repo: https://github.com/Kangkang-cai/altoclef-humanoid
- License: MIT (upstream AltoClef by Adris Jautakas; pathfinding by Baritone, LGPL-3.0)
- Target: Minecraft 1.18.2, Fabric, client-side mod, Java 17

## Key docs
- README.md — overview, features vs upstream, build & install
- usage.md — single-bot chat commands (`@gamer` beats the game, `@get`, `@food`, `@equip`)
- DOC_bridge_commands.md — multi-bot bridge: `/status` JSON schema, command protocol (`@follow`, `@give`, `@equip`, `@quota`), machine-readable receipts
- RECORDING.md — built-in input/behavior recording for debugging
- develop.md — development setup
